summary: Implemented rich_measure for Tree and VerticalCenter in the repository, with the related Align, Console.print, test, and changelog changes. Files changed: rich/tree.py (Tree.__rich_measure__ plus a Measurement import), rich/align.py (Align width constraint and repr; new VerticalCenter class), rich/console.py (render options use justify="default"), tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py (new tests), CHANGELOG.md (9.8.0 marked Unreleased, Added entry). Nothing was run and nothing was committed, so the test suite is unverified; run pytest on tests/test_align.py, tests/test_tree.py, and the full suite. One deviation: rich/tree.py gained a Measurement import, which the spec's no-new-imports line did not anticipate. I also used an inline Python snippet for the test and changelog text edits; it ran no repository code.
